parsed.summary: The patch addresses the NaN comparison issue by ensuring the result of the `cancel` function is assigned back to `ret`. This change is minimal and focused on the reported issue.

issues.description: The patch uses the Bareiss algorithm, which is not inherently limited to integer matrices. The change assumes that the algorithm can handle symbolic entries, but this assumption may not be valid in all cases. The patch does not address the underlying issue of why the Bareiss algorithm fails with symbolic entries.
